Apotheosis – Ascension to Godhood
Vol.3

Chapter 201
A crisp "ding" sound came from the crafting furnace, followed by black smoke billowing out from the crafting furnace.
The outer disciple looked back and his face turned ugly. "Oh no, what's going on? Is Senior Brother's Primordial Fire not enough? He can't suppress the materials in the furnace. The furnace is going to explode! "
The furnace was extremely hot, and the pressure inside and outside were different. In order to suppress the high pressure, the walls of the furnace were designed to be very thick.
Just relying on the walls of the furnace was not enough to suppress the energy in the furnace. Many times, rich experience and corresponding methods were needed to deal with the situation inside. When the materials were placed in the furnace, there would be a strange reaction. Every reaction had a different way of dealing with it, so experience and skills were especially important at this time.
This was also the reason why Xie Lang only had the strength of Half-step Innate, but the weapons he refined were far better than the Blue Cloud Sect disciples. Xie Lang was also restricted by the fact that no one taught him the orthodox refining methods. If there was an expert to guide him, Xie Lang would not only be able to refine the Upper Grade Xuan Weapon, but he might also be able to refine the Spiritual Weapon.
The Senior Brother of the 17th Academy, who was sitting at the top, had a very ugly expression.
An explosion was a big deal.
The crafting furnaces on Dipping Fire Peak were not cheap. Every crafting furnace was made of refined copper, and some rare metals were added to the inner walls. If the crafting furnace were to explode, no one would be able to bear the loss.
Therefore, at this moment, all the disciples of the 17th Academy were panicking.
"Mentor, I'll call the mentor!"
"This furnace will explode in the blink of an eye. By the time you call the mentor over, it will be too late!"
The inner and outer disciples were like ants on a hot pan, running in circles anxiously.
"Senior Brother, use your Primordial Fire to suppress it. Try your best to separate the sword embryo from the other materials in the furnace!" someone suggested.
The Eldest Senior Brother's face was covered in beads of sweat, and he kept pouring streams of True Fire into the crafting furnace. He clenched his teeth and said, "I've tried my best, but the sword embryo, Primordial Chaos Knot, and other materials are stuck together tightly. I really can't separate them!"
"Try your best, Senior Brother. Do your best!"
Faced with this sudden situation, Luo Zheng stood at the gate of the courtyard and blinked his eyes. Whether this crafting furnace exploded or not, it had nothing to do with him.
However, when he thought about how he originally wanted to borrow their crafting furnace, he decided to lend them a hand at this moment.
So Luo Zheng walked forward.
"What are you doing?" The previous Outer Sect disciple was also anxious at the moment, but he could only be anxious and couldn't do anything to help. Now that he suddenly saw Luo Zheng come in, he was angry. Now the courtyard was in a mess, and this brat actually came in to add to the chaos. Wasn't he looking for a beating?
Therefore, that Outer Sect disciple stretched out his fist and punched towards Luo Zheng.
Although the disciples of Dipping Fire Peak also cultivated, their main homework was refining weapons. Therefore, in terms of martial arts attainment, there was a big gap between them and the disciples of the 33 peaks. Even the weakest disciple, Xiao Yufeng, was far inferior to them, let alone this Outer Sect disciple who was only in the Marrow Refining Realm. How could his fist touch Luo Zheng?
Luo Zheng just moved his feet lightly. Like a ghost, he suddenly sped up to avoid the punch and then walked towards the Senior Brother with unhurried steps.
The Outer Sect disciple's punch missed. He was stunned for a moment and realized that this brat's strength was extraordinary. However, at this moment, he didn't want this guy to get close to the Senior Brother. He hurriedly shouted, "Everyone, stop that guy. He's making trouble. Quick, quick!"
Under the Outer Sect disciple's shout, several other disciples also surrounded Luo Zheng. However, no matter how they tried to stop him, they couldn't affect Luo Zheng's speed at all. He just dodged a little and still walked over at an unhurried speed.
Such a strange movement technique and speed was an eye-opener for these disciples.
Then, some of them realized that since this person's strength was so strong, he could totally help the Senior Brother!
Luo Zheng was indeed planning to help the "Eldest Senior Brother". When Luo Zheng passed by the crafting furnace, his speed suddenly increased. Before the "Eldest Senior Brother" could react, Luo Zheng had already reached out and patted the "Eldest Senior Brother" on the back.
Although Luo Zheng's control of the Heavenly Demon Vital Essence was not perfect, it was basically at a level where he could do it with ease.
For example, when Luo Zheng had just mastered the Heavenly Demon Vital Essence, he couldn't even control its devouring power. Now, Luo Zheng could completely control the Heavenly Demon Vital Essence. Most of the time, he could avoid the devouring power of the Heavenly Demon Vital Essence. Therefore, in Luo Zheng's Dantian, half of the Heavenly Demon Vital Essence and the other half of the Red Sandalwood Vital Essence.
At this moment, Luo Zheng said indifferently, "Relax!" Then, he patted the Senior Brother's back, and a steady stream of Heavenly Demon Vital Essence was poured into him.
The Senior Brother was originally a little nervous. He didn't know what Luo Zheng's actions were, but he didn't expect that Luo Zheng would pour Vital Essence into him. Moreover, this kid's Vital Essence was actually so vigorous and powerful.
He had already reached his limit. Using the Vital Essence in his hands to form a net of Vital Essence, he tightly bound the sword embryo and the materials that were undergoing violent changes in the crafting furnace. This was the only solution!
The more intense the sword embryo's reaction was, the faster the net of Vital Essence would be consumed. Seeing that his Vital Essence was close to exhaustion, once the sword embryo broke free from his Vital Essence, an explosion would inevitably occur.
But at this moment, he didn't have a better way. Other than bitterly holding on, there was no other way.
He didn't expect that Luo Zheng would give him such pure Vital Essence at this moment. For a moment, the Vital Essence in his hands suddenly became three times denser!
"Huff huff …" Streaks of fiery red Primordial Fire gushed out and continuously surged into the crafting furnace. The net of Primordial Fire formed by the Primordial Fire was instantly strengthened and firmly fixed the abnormal movements of the sword embryo.
When the disciples of the Seventeenth Courtyard saw the Senior Brother's Vital Essence flourish, and then the reaction in the crafting furnace slowly stopped, they breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, the way they looked at Luo Zheng was completely different.
They didn't expect that Luo Zheng would have such strength that he could help the Senior Brother pass through this hurdle!
After the Senior Brother's Vital Essence Fire spewed out for a while, he slowly stopped. At this moment, bursts of white smoke were coming out of the crafting furnace, indicating that the situation in the furnace was still good.
Before the crafting furnace was opened, the craftsman could judge the success rate of the refining based on the smoke coming out of the crafting furnace.
If pure black smoke came out, then the success rate was pitifully small, about 10% to 20% of the refining success rate. If black and white smoke came out, then the success rate was 30% to 50%. If white smoke came out, it meant that the impurities in the sword embryo and materials were fully burned. The success rate was very high, about 80%!
This was the first time that the disciples of the Seventeenth Courtyard were refining a High Level Profound Armament. They weren't sure about the success rate of the refining. As long as the furnace didn't explode during the refining process, even if black smoke came out, they could accept it. If white smoke came out, then they would thank the heavens and burn incense. But they didn't expect white smoke to come out of the furnace!
Seeing the white smoke, the faces of the disciples of the Seventeenth Courtyard suddenly showed ecstasy.
They didn't expect that the first time they tried to refine a High Level Profound Armament, they would succeed. This was not a very common thing in the Dipping Fire Peak, so it was inevitable that they would be very excited.
Although the white smoke came out and the success rate was only 80%, it was enough to make them look forward to it!
The Eldest Senior Brother sat on the spot and let out a deep breath. A smile appeared on his face. The situation where the furnace was about to explode had been forcefully reversed. It was as if he had walked through a life and death crisis. However, the most important thing was that he had to thank the person who had helped him.
Therefore, the Eldest Senior Brother turned around and cupped his hands towards Luo Zheng: "Many thanks to this dear friend for lending a hand at the critical moment. If not, the situation just now would be very bad. My name is Xu Han, the Eldest Senior Brother of the Seventeenth Courtyard."
Luo Zheng returned the greeting and introduced himself: "Luo Zheng, Xiao Yufeng's Outer Disciple."
Xu Han nodded and asked: "Brother Luo Zheng, did you come to our Dipping Fire Peak to refine a Profound Armament? Although I, Xu Han, am not proficient in my skills, refining high grade Profound Armaments is still somewhat lacking. You have also seen that this time when I was refining high grade Profound Armaments, the cauldron exploded. However, low grade and middle grade Profound Armaments should not be a problem, I can help! "
People were like this. If you take the initiative to help others, others will also take the initiative to help you.
Luo Zheng helped Xu Han escape the fate of a furnace explosion. Now, Xu Han wanted to help Luo Zheng refine a Profound Armament as a reward to Luo Zheng.
Not to mention a Profound Armament, even a Spirit Armament was nothing in Luo Zheng's eyes. Therefore, Luo Zheng shook his head and said with a smile: "Many thanks for Brother Xu Han's good intentions, but there is no need. I only came here to borrow your furnace!"

Chapter 202
It was the first time that an outer disciple of Xiao Yufeng had come to Dipping Fire Peak to borrow a crafting furnace.
Xu Han had indeed heard that some disciples were gifted geniuses who not only practiced martial arts but also had profound attainments in the art of crafting weapons.
But generally speaking, such disciples must have the support of aristocratic families. The crafting furnaces of those aristocratic families were much more advanced than the crafting furnaces of these disciples on Dipping Fire Peak. Why would they need to borrow one from them?
"That's true. I just want to borrow your crafting furnace. But don't worry, I won't let the furnace explode because I'm not using it to craft weapons, but to condense a weapon …" Luo Zheng explained.
This time, Xu Han was even more confused.
From Luo Zheng's tone, he was not a crafting master. But if he was not a crafting master, how could he want to condense a weapon? What the hell was this?
The so-called condensation was a crafting master condensing a trace of his understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination into a weapon. Only after condensation could the weapon produce a grade. It could be said that condensation was the most crucial part. The level of understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination directly determined the grade of a weapon.
As the saying went, without the skin, where would the hair attach?
If Luo Zheng was not a crafting master, how could he comprehend the Way of Heaven's Divination? Since he could not comprehend the Way of Heaven's Divination, what kind of condensation was he going to do?
Therefore, Xu Han felt that it was strange.
But …
Luo Zheng's request was not too excessive. If he only wanted to condense and not craft weapons, he could lend it to him. After all, there was no risk of the furnace exploding during condensation. As for whether it succeeded or not, it had nothing to do with Xu Han.
Besides, Luo Zheng had helped him a lot. If Luo Zheng had not appeared at this moment, the furnace in front of him would have been torn apart.
Therefore, Xu Han said, "If you only want to condense, it's not impossible. But you have to wait a while. I haven't condensed this upper grade profound weapon yet. It still needs some time."
Luo Zheng nodded and smiled. "Of course I can wait. You can finish your work first." With that, Luo Zheng stood aside.
Only then did Xu Han sit in front of the crafting furnace and release the Genuine Fire in his body again.
In fact, the condensation process did not require Genuine Fire. Whether it was Genuine Fire or Genuine Essence, one only needed to infuse Genuine Essence into the weapon according to his understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination to complete the condensation process.
If the heat of the True Fire was too high, it would not be good. Not to mention that the bottom of the furnace was originally connected to the volcanic vein. The underground lava continuously provided the furnace with heat. Even if the True Fire was not released, the temperature in the furnace would not be too low.
This was also the reason why Luo Zheng had chosen to come to Dipping Fire Peak. Luo Zheng did not specialize in fire-attribute cultivation techniques. For example, the Heavenly Demon's Quintessential Essence could not be used to refine weapons. Although Condensation did not require high temperatures, it still required a certain temperature in the crafting furnace.
The crafting furnace on Dipping Fire Peak was Luo Zheng's best choice.
Luo Zheng stood aside and waited for a while. He saw Xu Han push the Genuine Genuine Fire into the crafting furnace.
Compared to the raging Primordial Fire from before, the Primordial Fire he sent in now was much weaker. Furthermore, when Luo Zheng looked carefully, he could feel that within this Primordial Fire, there seemed to be some power that he could not explain clearly!
Although the power hidden in the Genuine Fire was extremely small, it was difficult to completely ignore.
"This power should be Xu Han's understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination!" Luo Zheng looked indifferently at the power hidden in the Genuine Fire.
The condensation process was the most critical stage in crafting weapons. Moreover, the duration of this stage could be long or short.
It was said that the length of the process depended entirely on one's perception and luck.
However, the length of time had little to do with the quality of the weapon.
In history, some craftsmen had left behind many legendary stories, especially the "condensation" stage. Because it involved the Way of Heaven's Divination, it was often said to be miraculous.
For example, someone had spent an entire month to refine a weapon! In this one month, he had been eating and drinking beside the crafting furnace. That crafting master felt that he had not condensed the weapon properly. After a month of continuous condensing, he opened the crafting furnace and really condensed a Celestial Artifact!
What's more, during the condensation process, he suddenly encountered a vision of heaven and earth. Lightning flashed, thunder roared, wind rose, and clouds surged. The whole condensation process only took the time it took to burn a stick of incense, and he also obtained a fairy weapon.
Because of this encounter, many inferior craftsmen misunderstood that crafting was a skill that depended on luck.
In fact, in the process of crafting weapons, there was a little bit of luck, but the most important thing was strength!
Generally speaking, the condensation process of an apprentice craftsman like Xu Han was not too short. It often took one to four hours.
However, Luo Zheng also had a lot of patience. He stood quietly by the side and did not say a word.
Unexpectedly, Xu Han's condensing process was very smooth this time. Only half an hour had passed by the sundial next to him. Xu Han withdrew the True Fire and then said with a smile, "It's done!"
The disciples of the 17th Courtyard who were waiting by the side also showed a happy expression. "Eldest Brother, it's really done!"
"Quick, quick, open the furnace and take a look. Take a look at the first Upper Grade Xuan Weapon of our 17th Courtyard!" Someone said urgently.
Xu Han walked to the side of the crafting furnace and reached out to open the lid of the crafting furnace. Before he put his hand in, Xu Han condensed a layer of True Fire on his hand and arm to protect his arm. At this time, the temperature in the crafting furnace was quite high, he had to use his own True Fire to resist the high temperature in the furnace to prevent himself from being burned.
By the time Xu Han retracted his hand, there was already a sword in his hand.
The treasured sword was silver-white in color. It shone brightly under the sun, sparkling with sparkling light.
"The grade has really reached the Upper Grade Xuan Weapon. I'll call this sword 'Seeking Water Sword'!" Xu Han held the sword in his hand and carefully looked at it. Xu Han's Junior Brothers swarmed around it, wanting to see the elegance of this Upper Grade Xuan Weapon.
Luo Zheng also slowly walked to Xu Han's side and said with a smile, "Congratulations, Brother Xu Han, for refining a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon."
Xu Han saw that Luo Zheng faintly glanced at the Upper Grade Xuan Weapon he had just refined. It seemed that the Upper Grade Xuan Weapon was not very pleasing to his eyes. Xu Han asked, "I've finished condensing. When will you use the crafting furnace?"
"Then let's use it now," Luo Zheng replied.
Xu Han stepped aside and waved his hand, "Please, Brother Luo Zheng, help yourself."
Xu Han was indeed curious. What kind of medicine was Luo Zheng selling in the gourd? A person who was not a craftsman, what kind of weapon did he want to condense?
Luo Zheng lightly tapped his Sumeru Ring and took out the sword from it.
Xu Han and the other disciples of the Seventeenth Courtyard saw the weapon in Luo Zheng's hand and their faces were suddenly shocked!
As craftsmen, they were quite sensitive to the quality of weapons!
Although the sword in Luo Zheng's hand had not been condensed, it was obviously not an ordinary weapon. It obviously came from the hands of a Master.
Just as Luo Zheng was about to put the sword into the crafting furnace, Xu Han stretched out his hand to stop him, "Brother Luo Zheng, the sword in your hand is extraordinary. If you ask a craftsman to condense it, it can at least condense a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon!"
Xu Han's meaning was very clear. Luo Zheng was not a craftsman. If such a beautiful sword was condensed by Luo Zheng, it would be destroyed by him. That would be a real waste of God's gift!
Since Luo Zheng was able to obtain such a treasured sword, he presumably was not someone who couldn't afford it. If he hired a good Blacksmith, he wouldn't need a Blacksmith Grandmaster to condense it into a high-grade spirit weapon. A high-grade spirit weapon! Just thinking about it made Xu Han excited.
However, Luo Zheng shook his head.
If he needed a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon, why would he spend so much effort? Wouldn't it be better to just buy one? Moreover, last time in the treasury of White Emperor City, Luo Zheng also had the opportunity to choose a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon. However, he gave up at that time and chose two crystals instead.
This time, he tried to use the Heaven's Divination Essence to condense an Immortal Weapon!
"Brother Xu Han, I appreciate your kindness. I just want to try and see if I can condense it successfully," Luo Zheng said with a smile.
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Xu Han felt like crying. How much of a wastrel was this guy? He wanted to try out such an exquisite weapon. Did he know what the price of trying it out was?
Weapons could not be condensed repeatedly. If the condensation was not successful, the weapon would basically be scrapped! Luo Zheng was basically playing with a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon …
Xu Han really wanted to stop Luo Zheng. However, he was not the owner of the sword. Naturally, he could only speak to the point. Seeing Luo Zheng's firm attitude, he had no reason to stop him.
Like Xu Han, the disciples of the 17th Academy were speechless at this moment. Some of them even showed anger on their faces. Obviously, they were deeply dissatisfied with Luo Zheng's waste.
Facing those regretful and angry gazes, Luo Zheng acted as if he did not see them and put the sword into the furnace.
"Hey, you don't use True Essence to protect your body?" Xu Han found another strange thing about Luo Zheng. He noticed that when Luo Zheng put the sword into the furnace, there was no protection on his hand. The problem was that Luo Zheng was not burned!
"Oh, the temperature in this furnace is not high, so I don't need to use it," Luo Zheng said with a smile.
"…"
Xu Han was completely speechless. Although Luo Zheng had just transferred a thick amount of True Essence to Luo Zheng, Xu Han knew that Luo Zheng was very strong. However, the furnace was connected to the underground fire vein. Moreover, he had just used True Essence to roast it, so the temperature was not ordinary.
If a pig was thrown in now, it would only take two breaths of time to roast the pig inside and out.
Luo Zheng put his hand in and acted as if nothing had happened. It was really unreasonable.
＝＝＝＝＝

Chapter 203
After putting away the treasured sword, Luo Zheng closed the door of the furnace and walked to the top, which was where Xu Han was refining. This place was right in front of the furnace's fire outlet.
After Luo Zheng sat down, a ball of Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan appeared in his hand.
This ball of Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan wrapped around his hand.
The Sky Evolution Essence was of great importance, so he had asked Zhang Wuxian to help him auction it. On one hand, he trusted Zhang Wuxian, and on the other hand, besides Zhang Wuxian, Luo Zheng had no better way to sell the Sky Evolution Essence. However, he didn't want to let a third person know that he had the Sky Evolution Essence except for himself and Zhang Wuxian.
As for the disciples of the 17th Courtyard, Luo Zheng certainly wouldn't let them know about it.
In order to achieve this effect, Luo Zheng could only do a little trick. The Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan was thick and was purple-black in color. He wrapped the Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan around his hand with the Sumeru Ring, and then took out a batch of Sky Evolution Essence from the ring.
The Sky Evolution Essence was mixed in the Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan and couldn't be seen from the outside.
After preparing, Luo Zheng spurted the Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan into the crafting furnace's fire mouth. The Sky Evolution Essence was wrapped in the Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan, so he couldn't guarantee that it was flawless. A real master would still be able to see it.
However, Luo Zheng believed that the disciples of the 17th Courtyard absolutely wouldn't be able to detect it.
The Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan formed a thick line and continuously poured the Sky Evolution Essence into the crafting furnace drop by drop.
Seeing the purple-black Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan, Xu Han's eyelids twitched. No wonder he felt that Luo Zheng's Zhen Yuan was very thick. This purple-black Zhen Yuan was indeed extraordinary. Although Luo Zheng was only at the Xiantian first stage, his strength couldn't be underestimated.
However, although this purple-black Heavenly Demon Zhen Yuan was special … it was useless for refining tools.
Xu Han clearly saw that this Zhen Yuan didn't contain the slightest trace of the Sky Evolution Dao. Luo Zheng didn't have any comprehension of the Sky Evolution Dao, so how could it be used for refining?
The other disciples of the 17th Courtyard sighed.
Alas, it seems like this Luo Zheng was just messing around. What a waste of such a good sword …
Luo Zheng was too lazy to care about what they thought. At this moment, he was concentrating on refining.
Luo Zheng did not understand the Dao of Heaven's Divination. In fact, he could not be considered to have condensed it. He could only be considered to have watered it with the Heaven's Divination Essence. It would depend on the grade of the sword that would be watered in the end.
Actually, Luo Zheng was a little uncertain. After all, this was his first time using the Heaven's Divination Essence to water a weapon. He might end up with a Xuan weapon or even a useless one if he used the wrong method.
After injecting the Heavenly Demon True Essence into the crafting furnace, Luo Zheng manipulated the Heavenly Demon True Essence to cover the treasure sword.
— —
The magma in the underground fire vein slowly flowed through the tunnel dug under the crafting furnace. Through heat conduction, the high temperature was continuously transmitted upwards.
The treasure sword was placed in the furnace and was baked by the heat emitted by the magma. During the refining process, a certain temperature had to be maintained. The temperature in the crafting furnace was neither too high nor too low. It was very suitable.
After the Heavenly Demon True Essence covered the treasure sword, the first drop of Heaven's Divination Essence was supported by the True Essence and dripped onto the blade of the treasure sword.
The moment the drop of Heaven's Divination Essence touched the blade of the treasure sword, a metallic ripple formed on the smooth blade. The ripple did not spread over a large area. It stopped after a few inches, leaving a demonic pattern on the blade.
Immediately after, the second drop of Heaven's Divination Essence also dripped onto the blade, leaving behind a similar pattern.
As the Heaven's Divination Essence increased, it fell onto the blade like raindrops. Patterns bloomed on the blade of the sword one after another.
At this moment, the Heaven's Divination Essence in Luo Zheng's ring was continuously being sent into the crafting furnace through the Heavenly Demon True Essence.
If some famous craftsmen saw Luo Zheng using the Heaven's Divination Essence like this, they would probably vomit blood in anger.
How precious was the Heaven's Divination Essence?
Generally speaking, using the Heaven's Divination Essence to refine a weapon would only be used on the most important part of the weapon. As the saying goes, good steel should be used on the blade.
If they were to use the Heaven's Divination Essence to refine a sword, the Heaven's Divination Essence would only be used on the blade. If the amount of Heaven's Divination Essence was insufficient, the Heaven's Divination Essence might be accurately placed on the blade of the treasure sword.
Although this would greatly reduce the effect of the Heaven's Divination Essence, it was something they had no choice but to do.
However, Luo Zheng did not have the slightest intention of conserving the Heaven's Divination Essence. He allowed the Heaven's Divination Essence to drip freely. Therefore, not only did the Heaven's Divination Essence enter the blade of the sword, but even the hilt of the sword was filled with Heaven's Divination Essence!
However, even this treasure sword could not absorb the Heaven's Divination Essence endlessly. There was a limit, and this limit depended on the craftsmen's skill in refining weapons.
In one breath, Luo Zheng sent hundreds of drops of Heaven's Divination Essence into the furnace. The entire treasure sword was enveloped by the Heaven's Divination Essence. The entire blade, hilt, and tip of the sword had been completely absorbed. It could be said that the Heaven's Divination Essence was close to saturation!
At this point, Luo Zheng withdrew the Heaven's Divination Essence that had not been absorbed from the furnace and flowed back into Luo Zheng's Sumeru Ring.
At this point, the refinement was basically complete. The time taken from start to finish was not very fast. In total, it took less than an incense stick's worth of time.
Seeing Luo Zheng gradually pull apart the Heavenly Demon Vital Energy, the disciples of the 17th Academy were still baffled. Xu Han was even more stunned. He asked, "Is the refinement finished?"
According to their knowledge of refining weapons, the refinement time varied. However, Luo Zheng's refinement time was simply too short. It was so short that it defied common sense!
Just from this point alone, Xu Han could confirm that Luo Zheng was completely teasing them!
Luo Zheng smiled. "The refinement is complete!"
"Then, Brother Luo Zheng, please open the furnace and let us see the result." Xu Han did not have any malice. He was really curious about what Luo Zheng wanted to do.
Luo Zheng walked to the front of the furnace. The moment he opened the lid of the furnace, a silver-white light suddenly shot out from the furnace's interior!
"Buzz buzz buzz!"
The silver-white light shot out from the mouth of the furnace and hit the wall beside the 17th Academy. A layer of the wall was abruptly removed by the silver-white light.
The moment Luo Zheng reached into the furnace and took out the treasure sword, the silver light from the treasure sword soared into the sky. An invisible wave spread out from the treasure sword to the surroundings!
"Buzz …"
At this moment, everyone on Dipping Fire Peak sensed that something was wrong!
Behind Dipping Fire Peak, that earthfire vein that extended from Purgatory Mountain ultimately gathered here, forming a deep pool that was one zhang in size. However, what this deep pool contained wasn't water, but rather surging magma, which was why this place could be called a fire pool.
Around the fire pool, there were two weapon refiners sitting on the side. They continuously summoned the true fire in their bodies and mixed it with the magma in the fire pool.
These two weapon refiners were the instructors on Dipping Fire Peak. One of them was called Yan Jie, and the other was called Jiang Min. Both of them had reached Xiantian seventh stage. Although their strength was not high, their attainments in weapon refinement were not bad. Although they were far from the level of a master, they were more than enough to be instructors on Dipping Fire Peak.
In order to make their true fire purer, weapon refiners would often choose to visualize flames.
There were many types of flames. The magma that erupted from underground could be considered one type. Only, the flames within magma were too berserk.
Through visualization, one could indeed greatly increase the power of one's true fire. However, the true fire would also become berserk and difficult to control.
That was why when the two of them visualized this fire pool, they would take a 'Clear Mind Pill' every incense stick's worth of time. When the Clear Mind Pill entered their mouths, it would produce a wave of yin and cool energy.
In reality, weapon refiners mostly cultivated fire attribute techniques, so this type of cold energy was a great taboo. However, that wave of yin and cool energy could move through their entire bodies, helping them suppress the berserk aura within the magma, calming their minds.
Right when they were concentrating on visualizing the magma in the fire pool, suddenly, a silver wave swept past their bodies, moreover quickly spreading into the distance.
The two's expressions immediately changed.
"This wave of fluctuation … this is a weapon refined by someone!" Yan Jie's face revealed an extremely serious expression, but he still wasn't willing to give his judgment.
Beside him, Jiang Min was the first to speak out, "This is the aftermath of a magic weapon being refined!"
Generally speaking, all ranked weapons, even if it was a low-grade profound level weapon, would produce a small wave of fluctuation when it was refined. It was just that the fluctuation was very light and ordinary people would not be able to detect it.
However, the fluctuation produced by a spiritual weapon was more objective. Even ordinary people could see it with their naked eyes, but the range of the fluctuation was only a few feet.
Although the fire pool where Yan Jie and Jiang Min were at was not far from Dipping Fire Peak, the fluctuation of a spiritual weapon naturally could not spread here!
Only when a Fairy Weapon was refined could it possibly release such a violent fluctuation!
Looking at the manner of the fluctuation, it spread to the fire pool without the slightest sign of stopping, spreading into the distance. The two of them could not determine the grade of this weapon.
"Who on earth is refining a Fairy Weapon on Dipping Fire Peak?" Yan Jie asked with a frown.
"Could it be that Qian Yu is refining a Fairy Weapon?" Jiang Min could not think of anything, so she could only guess.
Refining weapons was not the forte of the Blue Cloud Sect. From the situation at Dipping Fire Peak, it could be seen that out of the hundreds of thousands of disciples in the Blue Cloud Sect, only a mere thousand people were willing to embark on the path of refining weapons.
In all these years, the Blue Cloud Sect had only produced one Weapon Refining Grandmaster, who was also one of the three great Weapon Refining Grandmasters in the Burning Sky Empire. He was Qian Yu.
Jiang Min had just voiced her thoughts when Yan Jie immediately rejected it, "Impossible, Qian Yu is a Weapon Refining Grandmaster, how could he be willing to refine weapons on Dipping Fire Peak?"
The furnace used by the disciples on Dipping Fire Peak naturally could not enter Qian Yu's eyes. The Blue Cloud Sect had spent a lot of money to prepare the "Nine-patterned Earth Dragon Furnace" for Qian Yu. In the 17th Academy.

Chapter 204

Chapter 205

Jiang Min's Saber Qi rolled over. The Saber Qi emitted a gloomy feeling, which made people's hearts palpitate.

All martial artists in the early stages of cultivation would practice various skills, fist techniques, basic Saber Techniques, basic Sword Techniques … After they grew up, they would choose the direction of development according to their own characteristics. Jiang Min had chosen the path of a Refining Master, but she still knew the Basic Sword Technique.
Since Luo Zheng was only willing to use the Basic Sword Technique, it meant that he didn't originally use a sword!
Then, Luo Zheng must have other means that he hadn't used yet. Just the Basic Sword Technique was enough to deal with her!
She couldn't possibly be this person's opponent …

Chapter 209

But when he saw that Luo Zheng's disciple card was an outer disciple's token, he was stunned. When did outer disciples come here to join in the fun? Since he became a deacon here, he had never received an outer disciple.
The deacon raised his head with a look of astonishment. He looked at the name on Luo Zheng's disciple card and said slowly, "This disciple named Luo Zheng, we are going to the eighth floor of the Seven Stars Sword Light Platform. With your strength, I'm afraid it's not suitable for you to go in. You'd better line up at the side!"
The black-robed disciple who had kindly advised Luo Zheng had already finished registering. At this time, he turned back and said, "It's useless. I just told him that he insisted on going to the eighth floor!"
The deacon thought that Luo Zheng was not clear about the rules of the Seven Stars Sword Light Platform and was about to explain it to Luo Zheng. But when he heard the black-robed disciple's words, he understood that Luo Zheng originally intended to enter the eighth floor …
"Cough cough … this disciple, there is not only an illusory array in the Seven Stars Sword Light Platform, but also the magnetic aurora contained in the polar spirit stone. It can also hurt people!" The deacon continued to persuade.
"It's useless. I just told him that he still wants to go in," the black-robed disciple said again.
The deacon was at his wit's end and could only shrug his shoulders. He was only a deacon on the Seven Star Sword Radiance Platform and not Luo Zheng's teacher. His greatest duty was to inform Luo Zheng of the dangers and difficulties involved, but Luo Zheng simply didn't listen to his advice, so what else could he do?
So the deacon took Luo Zheng's disciple card and took out another token to give to Luo Zheng. He realized that it was Luo Zheng's first time entering the Seven Stars Sword Light Platform. At the same time, he told Luo Zheng, "With this token, you can choose the difficulty when you enter the Sword Light Platform. Different difficulties will deduct different points …"
"Okay, I'll keep that in mind." After Luo Zheng received the token, he followed the black-robed disciples inside.
The Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform was a very large and beautiful building. From the outside, it looked like an observation platform. In front of Luo Zheng, there were small terraced terraced platforms. The edges of the platforms were built with a circle of white marble railings. The railings were carved with all kinds of fierce beasts, dragons, and snakes.
After walking for a short distance, a small bridge appeared in the air. The width of the small bridge was only about the width of one person, and it was impossible for two people to cross side by side. Thus, all the disciples entered in a single file.
After walking for a while, the small bridges diverged, and each small bridge led to a platform.
The black-robed disciple in front of Luo Zheng suddenly turned around and asked Luo Zheng with a smile, "Which platform do you choose?"
The difficulty of each platform was different. The rightmost platform was marked with the word "Eight", which was the eighth level of difficulty. The left platform was marked with the word "Nine", which was the ninth level of difficulty. The center platform was marked with the word "Xi", which was the tenth level of difficulty.
Luo Zheng had come here for the first time, so he didn't have a rough idea of the difficulty of the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform. He shrugged his shoulders and said, "I don't know. Which difficulty do you choose? I'll go with you. "
The black-robed disciple smiled and said, "I'm at the Xiantian eighth stage, but I can barely adapt to the eighth level of difficulty." The implication was that he, a dignified Xiantian eighth stage master, could only adapt to the eighth level of difficulty. With Luo Zheng's strength, he was afraid that he wouldn't be able to survive.
"Well, I also choose!" Luo Zheng faintly smiled and followed the black-robed disciple.
The black-robed disciple shook his head. He had seen a lot of people who overestimated themselves, but he had never seen someone who overestimated himself like this. Fine, this kind of person would make him suffer a few times, so he took the lead and walked towards the eighth level of difficulty.
Along this path, just as he stepped onto the platform, the surrounding scenery suddenly changed. The illusion matrix on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform had been activated at this moment.
The illusion matrix on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform was not outstanding, and compared to other illusion matrices, it was even somewhat simple and crude. The reason was that this Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform was mainly used to hone the sword intent, and the most important thing to hone the sword intent was to concentrate the mind and fully blend the mind with the sword in the hand, and reach the stage of 'man and sword become one'.
After entering the platform, the black-robed disciple untied a long sword from his back.
The long sword was tightly wrapped. After the black-robed disciple untied many layers, the treasured sword in the middle was revealed. On the scabbard of the treasured sword, a dragon made of gold was entrenched in the scabbard, and it looked very mighty and domineering.
The black-robed disciple slowly pulled the sword out of the scabbard, making a crisp sword sound. He smiled at Luo Zheng and said: "This sword is called 'Torch Dragon', and it's a middle-grade spiritual weapon!"
This black-robed disciple was born in a landowning household, but his landowning household was not very powerful. In addition, he was a collateral disciple in the landowning household, and his status was not high. He was basically relying on himself to cultivate all the way to today's level. Being able to obtain a middle-grade spiritual weapon was enough for him to be proud.
After all, most of the black-robed disciples in the Blue Cloud Sect may only have one high-grade Xuan Weapon, or even one low-grade Xuan Weapon.
"It's a very beautiful treasured sword, but … I don't know how to cultivate on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform?" Luo Zheng looked around. The illusory array on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform was too simple. There was not even a scenery.
Everywhere was gray, and the line of sight was blocked by smoke. Compared to the exquisite illusory array on the Blood Red Mountain, it was simply a world of difference.
The black-robed disciple pointed not far away and said: "Do you see the two pillars in front?"
Luo Zheng looked not far away. There were indeed two pillars, and above the pillars were two crystal balls.
"Follow me!" The black-robed disciple held the treasured sword and led Luo Zheng to the two crystal balls. "Do you see the names on them?"
Luo Zheng looked over and saw the names engraved on the crystal balls. One of the crystal balls showed the two words "Luo Zheng", and the other crystal ball showed the two words "Zhao Zhao". Presumably, Zhao Zhao was the name of this black-robed disciple.
"This crystal ball belongs to you. In a while, when the illusory array on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform is activated, those polar spirit stones will release the Magnetic Aurora! The Magnetic Aurora will shoot from all directions, and you must use your sword to split the Magnetic Aurora! The power of the Magnetic Aurora will increase with the difficulty. If you hold an ordinary sword, I'm afraid that one Magnetic Aurora will destroy your sword. " While speaking, Zhao Zhao gently touched the blade of his precious sword named 'Torch Dragon'. Obviously, he had used this sword to deal with many Dimensional Magnetic Auroras.
So that's how it is. Luo Zheng quickly understood. In the end, the trial on the Big Dipper Sword Radiance Platform was to protect the crystal ball in the center. If the crystal ball was broken, the cultivation would be over. These swordsmen relied on the endless Magnetic Aurora to sharpen their sword intent.
"Rumble …"
Suddenly, the sound of thunder came from the sky.
"Alright, hurry up and draw your sword. The Protomagnetic Aurora is coming. Each crystal ball can only withstand three hits. When the crystal ball is hit three times by the Protomagnetic Aurora, it will shatter and you will be eliminated. Be careful!" Zhao Zhao warned.
Luo Zheng nodded. He took out the Flowing Light sword from his spatial ring, grasped the hilt, and gently pulled.
"Hum hum hum …"
A clear and melodious sword cry sounded out.
Zhao Zhao was waiting for Luo Zheng to draw his sword. He wanted to see just what kind of treasured sword Luo Zheng would be able to pull out.
When Zhao Zhao saw the Flowing Light sword in Luo Zheng's hand, he was immediately dumbfounded …
From the outside, Luo Zheng's Flowing Light sword was not as mighty and domineering as Zhao Zhao's Torch Dragon sword. It looked just like an ordinary sword. But looking at the bright silver luster flowing around the sword body, it gave people a soul-stirring feeling!
Especially when Zhao Zhao saw a looming immortal pattern on the sword body, he could not help but swallow his saliva. "This, this is an immortal tool!"
Luo Zheng gently shook the Flowing Light sword. The sword light was like an old dragon sucking in water, little by little. He turned his head and smiled at Zhao Zhao, "Probably."
Probably … …
Zhao Zhao felt that his throat was somewhat dry. A Xiantian second stage martial artist was said to carry an immortal tool with him!
According to Zhao Zhao's understanding, even a Xiantian great circle martial artist was not qualified to carry an immortal tool, because they simply could not display the power of an immortal tool. However, some Xiantian great circle martial artists were born in noble families. As the core disciples of noble families, under the care of their elders, it was possible for them to be bestowed an immortal tool!
But, but … …
This Luo Zheng was still an outer disciple, and his strength was only at Xiantian second stage. No matter how one looked at it, it was impossible for him to have an immortal tool. This was beyond common sense.
Zhao Zhao certainly did not think that this immortal tool was personally refined by Luo Zheng, and it was not bestowed by anyone. If it was really bestowed, then it was because of fate with the woman of Qianji Pavilion, who had given this semi-finished product to Luo Zheng.
Zhao Zhao was still in a daze. Not far away, two translucent auroras, as thick as the mouth of a bowl, were flashing a faint blue light. The two auroras were flying towards him at a moderate speed.
"Is this the Magnetic Auroras?" Luo Zheng stared at the approaching Magnetic Auroras, holding the Flowing Light sword in his hand and gently raising it, ready to attack.
Zhao Zhao's mentality at this moment was extremely unbalanced. How could a Xiantian second stage martial artist be able to wield an immortal tool! What kind of world was this? Wasn't this a reckless waste of natural resources? So what if he had an immortal tool? If he could not display the power of an immortal tool, then what was the difference between an immortal tool and a piece of wood in his hand?
Feeling indignant, Zhao Zhao jumped up and chopped at one of the Magnetic Auroras with the "Torch Dragon" in his hand. He wanted to let Luo Zheng understand that the sword was not the most important thing, but the person using the sword was the most important! Even if he was holding a middle-grade spirit tool, the power he could display was far stronger than Luo Zheng!
"Wild Dragon Roaring Sword!"
"Roar!"
Wild Dragon Roaring Sword was a very overbearing and powerful swordsmanship. Every time the sword was chopped out, it would form a dragon roar in the air, and its power was astonishing.
A dragon-shaped Sword Qi suddenly formed from Zhao Zhao's sword, and with a roar, it immediately rushed towards the Magnetic Auroras and entangled with them.
The Magnetic Auroras were a very sharp energy that could be used to hone sword intent. If the sword intent was sharp enough, then the Magnetic Auroras would be cut into pieces faster. On the other hand, if the sword intent was not sharp enough, then it would be difficult to break the Magnetic Auroras.
When Zhao Zhao's Sword Qi and the Magnetic Auroras entangled together, the Magnetic Auroras were bitten into pieces by the dragon-shaped Sword Qi and disintegrated. After a while, the Magnetic Auroras were torn into pieces by the dragon-shaped Sword Qi.
Seeing his results, Zhao Zhao's face showed a satisfied expression. Obviously, his sword intent had improved. Compared to the last time when he was fighting against the Magnetic Auroras, it was 10% faster. With this speed, he could probably last for 30 minutes in the eighth level of difficulty this time.
After Zhao Zhao dealt with his Magnetic Auroras, he looked at Luo Zheng. He wanted to see how Luo Zheng could display the power of an immortal tool!
Luo Zheng was still quietly standing in place. When the Magnetic Auroras approached, Luo Zheng's hand suddenly moved. The Flowing Light Sword in his hand suddenly slashed out, and it was still a simple "Sword Slash".
"Sword Slash?" Zhao Zhao's face showed a very awkward expression.
As a swordsman, he was very familiar with basic swordsmanship. This Luo Zheng did not practice any other swordsmanship? Only basic swordsmanship? Using an immortal tool to display basic swordsmanship?
Heavens … Zhao Zhao felt that his whole body was not good.
"Whoosh!"
With this simple slash, a half-moon shaped silver light was instantly formed. The bright silver light was so dazzling that it followed the direction Luo Zheng slashed out, and the sword light precisely cut into the middle of the Magnetic Auroras.

Chapter 210
The entire process took place in the blink of an eye. The time it took to destroy the Primary Magnetic Aurora was much shorter than Zhao Zhao's.
"…" Zhao Zhao's mouth was wide open. In such a short period of time, he had received so much stimulation that he felt a little sluggish.
Luo Zheng looked at Zhao Zhao's appearance and said faintly, "More Primary Magnetic Auroras are coming. Be careful!"
Not far away, another four Primary Magnetic Auroras were flying in their direction.
Zhao Zhao, who had been thoroughly defeated by Luo Zheng, felt a chill in his heart and his expression became serious.
The cultivation of swordsmanship was about protecting the heart of the sword, sharpening the sword intent, not being disturbed by external factors, and killing all inner demons.
Just now, Luo Zheng had repeatedly exceeded Zhao Zhao's expectations and caused Zhao Zhao's heart of the sword to become unstable. If the heart of the sword was unstable, the sword intent would also be weakened. In this way, the power of the sword in one's hand would also be affected. Therefore, the wavering of one's heart was a great taboo for swordsmen.
Seeing Zhao Zhao recover so quickly, Luo Zheng also smiled slightly. In the end, Zhao Zhao was a swordsman who cultivated swordsmanship. To be able to stabilize the heart of the sword in such a short period of time was very praiseworthy!
Luo Zheng didn't say much and also began to seriously deal with the Primary Magnetic Auroras!
The Primary Magnetic Auroras came wave after wave, and the number of waves was constantly increasing.
If the first wave only had one Primary Magnetic Auroras, then the second wave would have two, the third wave would have three, and so on.
In order to protect the crystal ball, the most important thing was to destroy the speed of the Primary Magnetic Auroras.
The Primary Magnetic Auroras were a kind of very pure energy. The auroras extracted from the polar spirit stones were very stable and were rarely disturbed by external factors.
Just like the dragon intent contained in Zhao Zhao's dragon-shaped sword qi, if used to fight against enemies or kill monsters, the effect would be good. However, it didn't have much effect on the Primary Magnetic Auroras. In order to cut the Primary Magnetic Auroras, one still relied on the sword intent, which was the pure understanding of swordsmanship!
Therefore, the Primary Magnetic Auroras were the best choice to sharpen the sword intent!
Luo Zheng and Zhao Zhao were constantly killing the Primary Magnetic Aurora, from the first wave all the way to the fifteenth wave.
This time, thirty Essencefused Auroras rushed over in one breath. Luo Zheng and Zhao Zhao each had fifteen.
"Break!"
The sword light in Luo Zheng's hand was like rippling waves in a lake. Layer upon layer, it slashed towards the magnetic auroras.
Waves of sword light crisscrossed back and forth, instantly killing the Protomagnetic Auroras.
The fifteen Essencefused Auroras were separated from each other, but how fast was Luo Zheng killing them? In a short while, they were all killed by Luo Zheng.
On the other hand, Zhao Zhao's speed was far inferior to Luo Zheng's. Zhao Zhao was already faintly struggling to deal with this.
He had to spend quite a bit of time on each of the magnetic auroras. Although the speed of the magnetic auroras was not particularly fast, they were still steadily flying towards the crystal in the middle. As long as one escaped the net, it would cause damage to the crystal. If there were three magnetic auroras, the crystal would be completely destroyed.
"Roar! Roar! "
Dragon-shaped sword beams slashed out from Zhao Zhao's' torch dragon '. As the Protomagnetic Auroras flew, Zhao Zhao destroyed 14 of them in one breath. However, in the end, one of the Protomagnetic Auroras slipped through the net and shot towards the crystal.
Zhao Zhao wanted to come back to save it, but it was already too late. He could only watch as the magnetic auroras drilled into the crystal.
"Crack!"
There was a thin crack extending from the crystal ball on the pillar.
Zhao Zhao's face was very ugly. He did not expect that this time, the first crack would appear after he had only persisted to the fifteenth wave. His previous best result was that the first crack appeared in the seventeenth wave. Compared to his previous results, he seemed to have regressed.
Luo Zheng looked indifferent and shook his head slightly. He could help Zhao Zhao, but the purpose of the Seven Stars Sword Radiance Platform was to hone one's sword intent. Relying on others' help would not have any effect. This could only depend on Zhao Zhao's own efforts.
After the cracks appeared on the crystal ball, Zhao Zhao clearly fought even harder. There were several times when he directly rushed to the magnetic auroras and brandished his sword.
Although the magnetic auroras' flight speed was not fast, if one was accidentally hit by the magnetic auroras, they would still be seriously injured. Therefore, Zhao Zhao's actions appeared very rash.
Although he was rash, the results were not bad after Zhao Zhao fought even harder. In the sixteenth and seventeenth waves, he did not miss any magnetic auroras.
And in these two waves, Luo Zheng still dealt with them very easily. Similarly, he did not miss any magnetic auroras.
However, when it came to the twentieth wave, Zhao Zhao missed another Proton Magnetic Aurora. The cracks on the crystal ball behind him had already spread to the middle of the ball. At this moment, his crystal ball was in imminent danger. If it was hit by another Proton Magnetic Aurora, it would completely shatter, and this cultivation session would come to an end.
After the end of the twentieth wave, Zhao Zhao sighed. Instead, he smiled and said, "Not bad. In the past, I could at most persist until the seventeenth wave without missing a single auroras. Then I missed one auroras in the eighteenth, nineteenth, and twentieth waves … this time, I was able to persist until the twentieth wave, but I'm afraid I won't be able to endure the twenty-first wave no matter what."
Zhao Zhao's heart was also full of frustration. Just now, he had looked down on Luo Zheng. He didn't expect that Luo Zheng would persist until now without any difficulty. Instead, it was he who was about to be eliminated …
Luo Zheng put away the Flowing Light Sword and said faintly, "How can you know if you don't try? What's more, this isn't a real battle. Even if you fight, you won't lose your life. Only in a desperate struggle can you comprehend the pinnacle of the Sword Dao. If you are willing to fight, you may be able to endure the twenty-first or twenty-second wave. If you give up in your heart, then you have truly given up. "
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Zhao Zhao was slightly taken aback. In his heart, he thought, "Yes, as long as I am a little careful, these Primary Magnetic Auroras won't hurt me so easily. Why don't I test my limits and see how far I can go?"
Thinking of this, Zhao Zhao's pupils contracted slightly. A sharp aura once again spread out from his body.
The aura of a swordsman was originally extremely sharp. Only by maintaining this sharp aura in his heart could he rely on the sword in his hand to break through all things in the world!
Unconsciously, even Zhao Zhao himself didn't realize that his understanding of the Sword Dao seemed to have deepened a little.
"The twenty-first wave is coming. Come on!" Luo Zheng said in a deep voice.
"Come on!" Zhao Zhao raised his Qi in one breath and gathered it all in the "Torch Dragon" sword in his hand. As he slashed out with his sword, dragon-shaped Sword Qi surged in all directions. On the entire platform, there were bursts of dragon roars coming from all directions.
Luo Zheng still stabilized his footwork and swung his sword at the Primary Magnetic Auroras coming from all directions. As the number of Primary Magnetic Auroras increased, Luo Zheng also gradually felt the pressure, but his pressure was not as great as Zhao Zhao's.
"Roar, roar, roar …"
Zhao Zhao killed twenty Primary Magnetic Auroras in one breath, but there was still a fish that escaped the net and flew in the direction of the crystal ball.
Although Zhao Zhao was already out of breath and couldn't catch up with the Primary Magnetic Auroras, when he thought of Luo Zheng's words and his own plan to put his life on the line, he forced himself to take a deep breath and madly ran toward the Primary Magnetic Auroras. At the same time, the Sword Qi in his hand rolled.
"Roar!"
Just before the Primary Magnetic Auroras hit the crystal ball, Zhao Zhao's dragon-shaped Sword Qi finally destroyed the Primary Magnetic Auroras.
Zhao Zhao's posture when he slashed out with his sword was wrong. His whole body hit the ground face first and fell heavily to the ground. When he got up, half of his face was blue.
Looking at Zhao Zhao's appearance, Luo Zheng mischievously smiled, "Not bad, you really went all out!"
Zhao Zhao gasped for breath and said, "Fortunately, this has already broken my record. I actually managed to survive the twenty-first wave! Incredible! "
Zhao Zhao had been cultivating on the Seven Star Sword Light Platform for more than a day or two. His previous best record was the twentieth wave. But there was one time when he managed to survive the twentieth wave, but that was because of the help of others. He barely managed to resist the last Primary Magnetic Auroras and reach the twenty-first wave …
Now, Zhao Zhao had relied on his own strength to survive the twenty-first wave and enter the twenty-second wave. This was truly incredible!
There was only a little time to rest between each wave. Zhao Zhao hadn't even caught his breath when the twenty-second wave came.
In the end, Zhao Zhao tried his best but still wasn't able to survive the twenty-second wave. The last Primary Magnetic Auroras mercilessly smashed his crystal ball … Zhao Zhao was like a person who had just been fished out of the water, his entire body drenched in sweat.
Relatively speaking, martial artists who used swords were much more graceful than those who used spears and sabers. It was rare for them to be in such a difficult situation. However, Zhao Zhao had pushed himself to the limit. This was a completely new experience for him.
He sat paralyzed on the ground. As he watched Luo Zheng calmly deal with the Primary Magnetic Auroras, he could only secretly sigh in his heart. This fellow was really an animal. This was his first time entering the Seven Star Sword Light Platform and he had already chosen the eighth level of difficulty. Not only that, but he was also able to calmly deal with the Primary Magnetic Auroras …

Chapter 211
Generally speaking, after Zhao Zhao failed, he would withdraw from this platform, but today he didn't want to leave. He wanted to see how long Luo Zheng could persist.
Waves of magnetic auroras continued to surge, and the number was constantly increasing, but Luo Zheng was still unhurriedly slashing his sword at those magnetic auroras.
Twenty-fifth wave … …
Thirtieth wave … …
Fortieth wave … …
Fiftieth wave … …
At this moment, whenever those magnetic auroras rushed towards Luo Zheng, there would be a large number of magnetic auroras. "These magnetic auroras are only sensitive to sword intent. Even if I use an immortal tool and rely on the Sword Qi of the flowing light sword, the cutting speed is still not fast enough." Luo Zheng frowned. In other words, Luo Zheng's comprehension of sword intent had not reached the level he wanted.
Sword, the head of all weapons, with its sharp blade, could cut through all things in the world.
Whether it was the basic swordsmanship or a variety of gorgeous and powerful swordsmanship, they didn't rely on brute force, but on the stimulation of sword intent to produce a sharp cutting power.
"How should I improve this sword intent?"
After feeling the pressure, Luo Zheng finally began to ponder.
"Break! Break for me! "
Luo Zheng slashed out his sword and instantly cut three magnetic auroras, but in the distance, more magnetic auroras rushed towards Luo Zheng.
Zhao Zhao looked at those magnetic aurora lights and said in his heart. It seemed that Luo Zheng was also unable to hold on any longer. Under Luo Zheng's wild slashes, the 61st wave was successfully passed. However, one of the Magnetic Auroras almost hit the crystal ball. Zhao Zhao judged that a crack would appear on Luo Zheng's crystal ball in the next wave. According to this trend, Luo Zheng shouldn't be able to withstand the 63rd wave …
With this result, he should be satisfied, Zhao Zhao thought as he sat by the side.
Who would have thought that right after the 61st wave, Luo Zheng would suddenly insert his Flowing-light Sword into the ground and close his eyes to meditate!

Luo Zheng remained motionless. His hands were placed on his knees. It seemed that he wasn't circulating his Zhen Yuan to regulate his body. Instead, he was thinking.

The interval between each wave of the Magnetic Auroras wasn't long. Luo Zheng didn't have much time to think. Before long, the dense Magnetic Auroras from not too far away flew over.

It won't be too late to challenge him in the future! "
But at this moment, Luo Zheng, who was sitting on the ground, suddenly opened his eyes.

When the Magnetic Auroras came into contact with Luo Zheng's sword light, they were instantly disintegrated by the sword light!

In this sixty-first wave, the time Luo Zheng spent was actually less than half of the time spent on the sixty-sixth wave.

At this moment, it seemed that using the word abnormal was no longer enough to describe Luo Zheng. This guy was an abnormal animal …

With his understanding of sword intent and Luo Zheng's own strength, these Magnetic Auroras were much easier to deal with.

"The eightieth wave!"
"The ninetieth wave!"
"The hundredth wave!"
After Luo Zheng had endured the hundredth wave, there was finally no movement on the platform.

Zhao Zhao nodded vigorously. He had already gotten used to Luo Zheng's abnormal expression. He only said in a slightly trembling voice, "The limit of the eighth level of difficulty is 100 waves, but there are only a few people who can really pass the hundredth wave …"
No matter who practiced, they would try their best to hone their sword intent.
For example, Zhao Zhao felt that the eighth level of difficulty was the most suitable for honing his sword intent, so he would always stay in the eighth level of difficulty. If he could endure forty or fifty waves, he would feel that the Magnetic Auroras below the eighth level of difficulty were no longer effective for him, and then he would choose the next level of difficulty.
At this moment, the deacon at the door suddenly heard a roaring sound coming from the array disc behind him.
"This sound … someone broke through the hundredth wave?"
The deacon was somewhat curious. Generally speaking, very few people were so persistent. Zhou Tong's strength lay in the fact that not only was his strength enormous, but he was also very skilled in the use of Zhen Yuan!

Chapter 226
Array flags were used to arrange an illusion array.
An illusion array master's ultimate goal was to draw an illusion array. It was impossible for them to draw an illusion array during a battle. Therefore, they would draw the illusion array on the array flags before the battle. This way, they would only need to throw out the array flags during the battle.
The most important thing to fight against an illusion array master was to prevent them from arranging the array flags. Once an illusion array master finished arranging the array flags, the illusion array would be very beneficial to the illusion array master. Whether it was an ordinary illusion array or an illusion killing array, the threat was very big.
Therefore, Zuo Yun's spear did not succeed. His next spear thrust towards the black battle flag on the ground.
However, at the same time that Zuo Yun thrust out his spear, a black fog escaped from the array flag. As soon as the fog appeared, it enveloped Zuo Yun.

Strictly speaking, this array flag was not used by Hei Ming to arrange an illusion array. The black array flag was just a bait. When Zuo Yun attacked this bait, the black array flag would release the black fog and bind Zuo Yun.
During a battle, no one would allow an illusion array master to easily arrange an illusion array. However, an illusion array master's fighting style was flexible and varied. Zuo Yun was not careful for a long time.

Chapter 235
Yue Qi stood there with a feeling of being as steady as Mount Tai.
To be able to stand out from the many talented disciples of Emerald Peak and step by step to become the second in the inner sect, Yue Qi sweated too much.

With the best mentality and enough hard work, it was enough for him to surpass those "geniuses" by a hundred times.

From beginning to end, Hua Tianming did not draw his sword. The reason was not that he looked down on his opponent. On the contrary, Hua Tianming attached great importance to every one of his opponents.
The Peak Grand Competition was not only a competition of strength, but also endurance and scheming.
Although Hua Tianming's strength was strong, he was still at the Connate Full Circle. If he wanted to reach the top in the Peak Grand Competition, how strong would his opponents be?

Luo Yan from the previous Peak Grand Competition, Xu Xiuyuan from the previous Peak Grand Competition, and Lou Chong from the previous Peak Grand Competition. Looking at the previous Peak Grand Competitions, other than a few genius dark horses that appeared out of nowhere, the personal disciples were usually able to occupy the top 20!

"Cloud Dragon Scout!"

Strands of True Essence coiled around Yue Qi's spear shaft, and if one looked carefully, they would be able to see that the True Essence had transformed into a blurry dragon shadow, constantly revolving around the spear shaft.
Just the first move was already so powerful!
Just as Yue Qi had said, he would not hold back just because Hua Tianming was a Connate Perfected Great Perfection expert. On the contrary, he would go all out once he attacked.
"Cloud Dragon Testing the Sky. This move is very powerful. I wonder how Hua Tianming will handle it!"
Yue Qi's' Rain-Dragon Spear Art 'attack is divided into two parts. The first part is the spear, and the second part is the eruption of true essence. The first part is the spear, and the second part is the eruption of true essence. The first part is already so astonishing. If the true essence erupts, the power is simply unimaginable. Hua Tianming wants to receive this spear with his bare hands? Heh, he's overestimating himself!
Looking at Yue Qi's astonishing spear, Hua Tianming's face also revealed a dignified expression. His feet moved, and he dodged to the side at an extremely fast speed.
"Dodge? Do you think my Cloud Dragon Testing the Sky is so easy to dodge? " Yue Qi held the nine feet nine inches long spear in one hand. This spear, which weighed a hundred pounds, seemed to have become a part of Yue Qi's body. It was abnormally agile. No matter how Hua Tianming dodged, the tip of the spear remained the same, pointing straight at Hua Tianming. The distance between the two was getting closer and closer.
In other words, Hua Tianming could not dodge this spear.
At this moment, Hua Tianming suddenly used a strange footwork.
Footwork was generally divided into several categories. Some focused on nimble turns, such as the 'Hundred Steps of Disorientation'. Others used dazzling phantoms to confuse the opponent, such as the 'Treading Water Crossing'. No matter what kind of footwork was used, it was impossible to dodge Yue Qi's spear.
Yue Qi's spear technique walked the path of calmness and steadiness. It specialized in breaking the unconventional and opportunistic moves of the sword.
However, Hua Tianming's footwork was very strange. Every time he took a step, there would be a faint shadow of a sword under his feet pointing in a direction. He would constantly change directions according to this shadow of a sword. His body was neither fast nor slow, but it just happened to avoid Yue Qi's spear.
"Sword Steps! That's Sword Steps! Hua Tianming has comprehended the Sword Steps! "Someone suddenly yelled from below the stage.
"It really is Sword Steps! This Hua Tianming is too monstrous. He hasn't drawn his sword until now. I don't know how strong he is, but just Sword Steps alone are better than 99% of the Blue Cloud Sect's disciples! "someone exclaimed.
Sword Steps were a special kind of footwork. The distance of every step was exactly the same as the length of the sword.
Because every step was limited by the distance, the flexibility of the Sword Steps would naturally be greatly reduced. But the Sword Steps were comprehended from the Sword Intent. If one reached the Small Success Stage of the Sword Intent, combined with the area covered by the Sword Intent, the Sword Steps would be far faster than an ordinary movement technique!
Moreover, Sword Steps were a footwork used to attack! Every step he took would shatter the air currents and form cyclones that contained sword intent. With a casual kick, he could shoot out those cyclones high up in the air.
"Pa pa pa pa …"
Hua Tianming's Sword Steps had already reached Initial Success. Although his footsteps were light, the Sword Intent beneath his feet cut through the air, creating vibrations that produced crisp sounds.
Relying on Sword Steps, Hua Tianming easily dodged Yue Qi's spear.
When Luo Zheng saw Hua Tianming's Sword Steps, his heart was slightly moved.
During this period of time, Luo Zheng constantly entered the Seven Stars Sword Light Platform to hone his Sword Intent. His comprehension of Sword Intent was also maturing day by day. Even though Luo Zheng felt that Hua Tianming's Sword Intent was extraordinary, Luo Zheng also believed that his own Sword Intent would not lose to Hua Tianming's.
However, he never thought that Sword Intent could be used in footwork.
Countless swordsmen in the world dreamed of comprehending their own Sword Steps. However, judging from the movements and footwork of Sword Steps, it was not difficult to practice.
The greatest difficulty of Sword Steps was precisely the fusion of footwork and Sword Intent. From a certain point of view, Sword Steps were actually the elementary form of One with the Sword.
Hua Tianming dodged Yue Qi's spear. Suddenly, he drew a line on the ground and hung upside down in the air. With a pull of his feet, a dignified Sword Intent flew toward Yue Qi.
In the face of Hua Tianming's Sword Steps, Yue Qi did not dare to be negligent. The spear in his hand spun rapidly like a windmill. The Sword Intent hit his rapidly spinning spear shaft and made a series of noises.
"Pa pa pa pa …"
Just the Sword Intent drawn from Sword Steps had such power. Even though Yue Qi was like a mountain, waving his spear to block all the attacks, he could not help but retreat.
The battle on the platform continued. The more the disciples of the Blue Cloud Sect watched, the more shocked they were. Even the personal disciples were concentrating on watching the battle on the arena. As for the other battles at the same time, no one paid attention to them.
Hua Tianming's performance was too amazing. This made the personal disciples, who had always been arrogant, pay attention to him.
After all, Hua Tianming was famous. Even Yue Qi could not make him draw his sword. Instead, he was suppressed by Hua Tianming's Sword Steps. This was enough to show that Hua Tianming's hidden strength was very terrifying.
The personal disciples were not fools. Their arrogance was not inherent. They did not pay attention to their opponents because most of them were not worthy of their attention. Everyone's eyes were focused on the arena. Luo Zheng slowly stepped out from behind the crowd and paced back and forth.
If someone saw his footwork, they would be surprised to find that his footwork was exactly the same as Hua Tianming's on the platform!
However, Luo Zheng did not imbue Sword Intent into it. The Sword Steps without Sword Intent looked very awkward. It was as if this set of footwork lacked a soul.
"One Step, Two Steps, Three Steps …"
It was reasonable to say that even if Luo Zheng's memory was very strong, it was impossible for him to completely remember every movement of Hua Tianming's Sword Steps after seeing them once. After all, the swordsmanship was very changeable. It was almost ever-changing.
However, the Sword Steps were comprehended through Sword Intent. Luo Zheng relied on his comprehension of Sword Intent. He only needed to remember a rough embryonic form and naturally deduced it from Hua Tianming's Sword Steps.
In the beginning, Luo Zheng would pause for a while after every step. He was using Sword Intent to deduce how to take the next step.
After Luo Zheng gradually deduced the footwork and key points of the entire set of Sword Steps, his speed became faster and faster. At the beginning, he took one step in a breath. Then, he took two steps in a breath. As his comprehension deepened and he became more familiar with the Sword Steps, his speed became faster and faster!
Soon, Luo Zheng was able to walk as if he was flying. He had basically mastered the Sword Steps.
"If I use it alone, it's okay. However, it's still far from enough to fight against an enemy because I have to use different footwork according to the enemy's attack. It seems that this Sword Steps can only be continuously honed in battle." Luo Zheng shook his head. Even if it was a supreme magical power, it couldn't be built behind closed doors. All martial arts skills needed to be tested in actual combat. Otherwise, it would only be an armchair strategist.
Everyone was paying attention to the battle between Hua Tianming and Yue Qi in the arena.
However, Zuo Yun did not pay attention to the arena. He was concentrating on healing his injuries at the moment.
The Scarlet Cloud Pill's medicinal efficacy came in waves. Every half an hour, it would release a quarter of its medicinal efficacy. When the medicinal efficacy was released, he had to use his true essence to completely absorb the medicinal efficacy of the Scarlet Cloud Pill. At this moment, his injuries had been completely stabilized. As long as he didn't fight, no one would be able to tell that he had suffered any injuries.
After absorbing this wave of medicinal efficacy, Zuo Yun opened his eyes. Seeing Hua Tianming's strange and sharp Sword Steps in the arena, he couldn't help but sigh in his heart. They were both in the Xiantian Full Circle realm, but Hua Tianming's strength far exceeded his. Just by relying on Sword Steps, without even drawing his sword, Hua Tianming was able to suppress the Divine Reflection Stage Yue Qi. This was the difference in talent!

Chapter 237

Chapter 255

Six meridian sword wielding methods were generally used by Divine Reflection experts. At this moment, they would add the Guanchong, Zhongchong, and Shangyang meridians, and wrap the sword hilt with true essence from the six meridians.
The pinnacle of a swordsman was the so-called 'one with the sword'. Using true essence to link with one's sword was the foundation of 'one with the sword'.
