However, you are destined to be unable to surpass me, but if you don't even have the courage to chase after me, then you might as well die, because although your talent is outstanding, your heart of martial arts is far from firm. Just a little setback will make you unable to extricate yourself. Even if you have not encountered it, you will not be able to go too far … "
"The world is so big, and the human population in the Eastern Domain is in the trillions. I heard that the Central Domain is ten times larger than the Eastern Domain. The genius disciples born in the Central Domain have been nourished with various elixirs since childhood, and the cultivation methods they practice are far beyond the Heaven Stage. Their masters are unfathomable, and they have inherited the talent of their parents. Perhaps some geniuses can defeat you at the age of ten or even younger. Even now, compared to them, I am still insignificant. Your so-called pride is just an arrogant lie …"
"If you understand this, then you should understand that your pride is nothing but an illusion. Shatter it and cultivate with your feet on the ground. You might still have a chance to catch up to me. Otherwise, you'll just be a piece of trash in this world. No, not only will you be a piece of trash in the future, but this also proves that you were a piece of trash before!"
Luo Zheng's words pierced Wang Yanmiao's heart. Every word was like a knife piercing Wang Yanmiao's heart and penetrating his brain.
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Ouyang Tang Zuo couldn't help but roar, "Luo Zheng! You've already won against Wang Yanmiao, don't go too far! "
It was indeed too much of a bully. Wang Yanmiao was already on the verge of going mad, and Luo Zheng still wanted to step on her.
Although most people were optimistic about Wang Yanmiao before, and Luo Zheng easily reversed the situation and defeated Luo Zheng, in fact, many people still stood on Luo Zheng's side.
After all, in their eyes, Luo Zheng was the inferior party. He was born in the grass roots, while Wang Yanmiao was a descendant of a landowning household and a direct disciple under Ouyang Tang Zuo. Wang Yanmiao was incomparably strong, not to mention that he had vainly tried to encroach on Luo Zheng's younger sister, Luo Yan. The public's subconscious generally liked to stand on the weak side against the strong.
But after Luo Zheng's words, the situation suddenly reversed.
Adding insult to injury at this time was tantamount to pushing Wang Yanmiao into the fire pit. It was too much.
However, Luo Zheng turned a deaf ear. He just stood in the gradually dissipating lotus and looked at Wang Yanmiao like a spring breeze. At this moment, even though Luo Zheng had a faint smile on his face, everyone saw it as endless ridicule.
Many people sighed at this moment: Wang Yanmiao was finished. In the future, they would probably never see this genius disciple who was doted on by thousands of people. The Blue Cloud Sect would probably have one more idiot because of this.
But right at this moment, a lotus shadow suddenly appeared beneath Wang Yanmiao's feet. At the same time, the blank and sorrowful expression on Wang Yanmiao's face was swept away, replaced by an ethereal expression. He seemed to be looking at everyone, but at the same time, he didn't seem to be looking at anyone. This strange situation lasted for a few breaths of time before he closed his eyes.
At the same time, a huge lotus phantom appeared under his feet!
Then, an incomparably holy, elegant, and fragrant white lotus grew rapidly. As soon as the white lotus appeared, it wrapped around him.
"This is …" Ouyang Tang took a deep breath and was so shocked that he was speechless.
Shi Jingtian also stood up from his chair. Although he expected Luo Zheng to defeat Wang Yanmiao, he never expected such a thing to happen. After staring blankly for a while, he shook his head with a smile and said, "I didn't expect that I still underestimated Luo Zheng. He knew that Wang Yanmiao was on the verge of Qi Deviation, but he still used words to provoke Wang Yanmiao. He wanted to help Wang Yanmiao and stimulate Wang Yanmiao to regain his martial heart. I didn't expect the effect to be so good. Wang Yanmiao actually had an epiphany!"
Epiphany …
Elder Xu stared blankly at the huge white lotus. His eyes were also filled with envy.
For every martial artist, this was an opportunity that could only be encountered by chance. Elder Xu had lived for so many years, but he had never experienced an epiphany. Moreover, the stronger one was, the deeper one's understanding of martial arts was, and the harder it was to have an epiphany. After all, epiphany required a certain level of ignorance of martial arts. If one was already halfway through, it would be difficult to have an epiphany.
Wang Yanmiao had already stepped into the Divine Reflection Realm. After this epiphany, his strength would increase by quite a bit!
Who would have thought that Luo Zheng's words would have such an effect?
What was even more frightening was that Luo Zheng's calm expression seemed to have already expected this to happen!
"Wang Yanmiao was originally at the peak of the Divine Reflection Realm. Among all the pro-disciples, his strength was at the top. If he had an epiphany this time, I'm afraid no pro-disciple would be his opponent!"
"It's undeniable that Wang Yanmiao's epiphany will indeed increase his strength greatly. Especially in this kind of despair, he can often break through his own bottleneck in an instant. However, it's better not to say that pro-disciples are invincible. Although the realm is important in a battle between martial artists, look at Luo Zheng. He's only at the Xiantian Second Stage. He has already broken through this common sense!"
"Yes, yes. For example, Hua Tianming hasn't drawn his sword so far. Who knows how terrifying he will be after he draws his sword? Perhaps with Hua Tianming's Xiantian Full Circle strength, he might be able to sweep away all the pro-disciples! "
Because Wang Yanmiao had entered a state of epiphany, the battle in the Transmigration competition was suspended. After about the time it took for an incense stick to burn, a crack suddenly appeared on the surface of the white lotus around Wang Yanmiao. The crack continued to spread and finally covered the entire lotus.
In the end, the white lotus collapsed. Wang Yanmiao, who was sitting in it, opened his eyes.
At this moment, Wang Yanmiao seemed to have taken on a new look. His eyes were full of vitality. His temperament changed slightly after the epiphany. The fierce domineering aura in his Qi Power faded away and was replaced by a kind of tranquil and noble Qi Power!
"I've always thought that this All-Peak Grand Competition was already in my bag, and I only needed to take it. When I met you in the first round, I thought it would be easier, but I didn't expect to be defeated like this. Moreover, I lost so miserably. I couldn't figure out why I lost to you like this, but now I understand!"
The world was so big. No matter how powerful a genius was, he had to have the awareness of a frog at the bottom of a well!
It was not terrible to be a frog at the bottom of a well. What was terrible was to have a narrow vision and not be able to stand the stimulation of the outside world, leading to Qigong Deviation.
Wang Yanmiao's enlightenment in an instant broadened his state of mind by countless times. He even vaguely touched a trace of Zen in his "Lotus Treasure Mirror".
Ouyang Tangzhe had once told Wang Yanmiao that although the Lotus Treasure Mirror was a Heaven-class cultivation technique, its power far exceeded that of ordinary Heaven-class cultivation techniques. It could not be compared to ordinary Heavenly Tribulation cultivation techniques.
Because the "Lotus Treasure Mirror" was passed down from a superpower in the Central Domain, if one wanted to exert its full power, he had to comprehend a trace of "Zen" in it.
Now, Wang Yanmiao had touched the Zen in it. He believed that as long as he was given time, he would completely understand it.
"Thank you!" Wang Yanmiao's expression was indifferent. He bowed to Luo Zheng and then walked down from the arena. When he arrived in front of Ouyang Tang, Wang Yanmiao bowed deeply again. "Master, this disciple has deeply comprehended and wants to cultivate in seclusion. I'm afraid this disciple will not be able to participate in the remaining matches of the Peak Competition."
"This …" A trace of hesitation appeared on Ouyang Tangzui's face. After all, Ouyang Tangzui still attached great importance to the All-Peak Grand Competition. If Wang Yanmiao could get into the top three of the All-Peak Grand Competition, then as her master, he would also feel proud. Moreover, the top three of the All-Peak Grand Competition would also be able to walk the Blue Clouds Road once. This Blue Clouds Road was also very beneficial to Wang Yanmiao.
However, when he saw Wang Yanmiao's appearance, Ouyang Tang's expression changed. Perhaps Wang Yanmiao had comprehended something incomparably important during his moment of enlightenment. In that case, it would definitely be best for him to cultivate in seclusion and digest those things. After all, this Azure Clouds Road could be walked after three years, and sudden enlightenment was a great opportunity. Many people might not encounter it even once in their lifetime …
Therefore, Ouyang Tang nodded. "Yanmiao, I permit you to cultivate in seclusion."
The battle between Luo Zheng and Wang Yanmiao could be said to be abnormally complicated. Who would have thought that Wang Yanmiao would be able to inexplicably turn the tables on Luo Zheng when he had the advantage and even used an ancient immortal artifact? Even now, no one could tell that Luo Zheng had used the power of vibration to send Wang Yanmiao's sword flying.

Chapter 257

Chapter 258

Three hundred years ago, after the Jiang Family was disintegrated by the Fengwang Dynasty, a large number of treasures and wealth were sealed in a mystic realm of the Shadow Clan. This snake-shaped short sword naturally passed into Jiang Shili's hands.
First, use the soul attack to confuse the opponent's mind, then use the snake-shaped short sword to slit the opponent's throat. This assassination method was very simple, but it was impossible to guard against!
Generally speaking, as long as the opponent's soul was not strong enough to withstand his soul attack, then he would not be able to dodge his snake-shaped short sword!
Luo Zheng's physical body was strong, but it was impossible for him to block his snake-shaped short sword!
Therefore, in Jiang Shili's opinion, Luo Zheng would definitely die with his two-pronged attack!
"Die!"
I'm destined to become a famous assassin in this world, and you'll only become a pile of bones.
As for the grasshoppers who mocked him in the arena, they were destined to look up to him and listen to his legend!
But the moment Jiang Shili's soul attack poured into Luo Zheng's mind, there was a sudden change!
Soul attack, to put it bluntly, was a battle of the soul.
Jiang Shili had been consuming Soul Cultivation Grass since he was a child, which made his soul much stronger than ordinary people.
Although the Soul Cultivation Grass was precious, it had a limited effect on the improvement of soul power.
This could not be helped. Even in the Blue Cloud Sect, there were a few secret manuals that used soul attacks, but there was not a single one that specialized in cultivating the soul!
It was too difficult to cultivate the soul. Therefore, it was very difficult and costly to use the Soul Cultivation Grass to nourish the soul.
However, Luo Zheng's soul had been tempered by that mysterious giant furnace.
That kind of inhumane torture could be said to have completely transformed Luo Zheng's soul!
In fact, there were ways to train the soul. Some ascetics would use some extreme methods to train the soul. The problem was that the soul was extremely fragile. If they were not careful, it was very likely that their soul would be damaged. If it was more serious, they might even become an idiot.
However, while Luo Zheng's soul was being refined by the black fire, it was also being repaired by the seven-colored light from the huge furnace!
It was easy to imagine the strength of his soul that was tempered like this.
In comparison, Jiang Shili's soul was simply too weak!
Therefore, in the face of Jiang Shili's murderous intent, Luo Zheng only felt a chill in his heart. At the same time, after suffering Jiang Shili's soul attack, Luo Zheng's eyes flashed slightly, but he did not react.
The battle between souls was often like this. The winner could be determined in an instant.
Legend had it that some powerful people could fight in the soul space. Two peerless masters could only rely on the battle between their souls to determine the winner. At that time, the soul attack was almost equal to the strength of the person. However, that level of battle was far from the level that Luo Zheng and Jiang Shili could come into contact with.
"Soul attack?" Luo Zheng sneered. After resisting Jiang Shili's soul attack that had softened his murderous intent, a gray spike condensed in his mind. The spike suddenly popped out from between Luo Zheng's eyebrows and went straight for Jiang Shili.
At the same time, Luo Zheng also had a flying dagger in his hand.
Broken Flying Dagger!
Jiang Shili's double assassination method was very similar to Luo Zheng's method.
It was the same method of using a soul attack to distract the opponent and the same method of using a flying dagger to assassinate.
The reason why Luo Zheng had not used this method was that, on the one hand, he wanted to save his trump card for later. On the other hand, this method was Luo Zheng's killer move.
With the sharpness of the broken flying dagger, Luo Zheng himself might not be able to control it well. It might even take someone's life!
Although everyone was giving it their all in the arena, there would occasionally be serious injuries or even deaths.
However, the arena was not a battlefield of life and death, so Luo Zheng still had to abide by some bottom lines.
However, Luo Zheng's bottom line had been broken.
Because he felt Jiang Shili's murderous intent towards him. This guy's purpose from the beginning was not to defeat him, but to kill him.
Luo Zheng had a set of standards in his heart for good and evil. This set of standards was very simple. If others were good to him, he would be good to them. If others wanted to kill him, there was no room for him to stay!
Being kind to one's enemy was being cruel to oneself!
Although Wang Yanmiao was hateful, Luo Zheng did not feel any murderous intent from Wang Yanmiao! This was because Wang Yanmiao only wanted to step on him ruthlessly and destroy his martial arts heart. That was why Luo Zheng let Wang Yanmiao off and even helped him when Wang Yanmiao was in a state of Qi deviation!
However, since Jiang Shili wanted to kill him, Luo Zheng did not have any scruples!
In fact, from the beginning, Luo Zheng had been on guard against Jiang Shili's murderous intent. Luo Zheng could roughly guess that Jiang Shili's murderous intent towards him came from the instructions of Perfected Zi Qing and Zhenren Tianqiong. However, this speculation could only be kept in Luo Zheng's mind. Naturally, he would not say this to the Blue Cloud Sect disciples without any evidence.
While Luo Zheng was on guard, he also grasped Jiang Shili's mentality. Frankly speaking, if Jiang Shili continued to waste time with Luo Zheng, Luo Zheng really did not have a good way to deal with him.
However, Luo Zheng understood that Jiang Shili was angry because of his words. Although Jiang Shili was very strong, he was not a competent killer. That was why Luo Zheng sat on the ground, said those words, and led the Blue Cloud Sect disciples to further anger Jiang Shili.
When Jiang Shili sensed that Luo Zheng had blocked his soul attack, his expression changed drastically!
He realized that he was very wrong!
Luo Zheng's soul attack that Wang Yanmiao mentioned was definitely Luo Zheng's greatest reliance!
How could this be? How could it be? With the strength of a Xiantian Second Stage, his physical body was already terrifyingly strong. How could his soul be so strong as well? His soul attack did not cause any harm to him? Was this guy still human?
Just as he was shouting these questions in his heart, Luo Zheng's Stun Spirit Spike had already launched a counterattack.

However, compared to Luo Zheng's previous opponents, Jiang Shili's performance was still not good.
Because Jiang Shili had nurtured his soul since he was young, his soul was much stronger than the average warrior. Although Luo Zheng's Stun Spirit Spike was powerful, Jiang Shili's soul could still withstand it.
Therefore, although Jiang Shili was in pain, he did not really faint. Even though he was at a disadvantage in the battle of souls, he still had the snake-shaped dagger.
As long as the snake-shaped dagger pierced through Luo Zheng's body, there was no way he could survive.
However, at this moment, he saw a broken flying dagger appear in Luo Zheng's hand.
"A piece of junk?" Jiang Shili snorted coldly in his heart. You want to block my snake-shaped dagger with this thing?
Not to mention that his snake-shaped dagger was an immortal weapon.
Even if the broken flying dagger in Luo Zheng's hand was also an immortal weapon, the essence of the Sky Eye would continue to dissipate over time. The more damaged it was, the faster it dissipated.
Looking at the broken flying dagger in Luo Zheng's hand, according to Jiang Shili's estimation, its power was at most equivalent to an inferior-grade spiritual weapon.
It could not block his snake-shaped dagger at all.
However, the moment the two daggers intersected, Jiang Shili was stunned.
He saw the broken flying dagger in Luo Zheng's hand send his snake-shaped dagger flying. Jiang Shili could clearly see that there was a crack on the blade of his snake-shaped dagger!
This was because the two flying daggers were not intersecting in a straight line. The snake-shaped dagger only brushed past the broken flying dagger from the side, so the damage was minimal.
If the two had collided head-on, Jiang Shili's snake-shaped dagger would have broken into two!
What kind of flying dagger was this? It still had such power even after being broken!
Jiang Shili was dumbfounded. While he was still in shock, the broken flying dagger flew toward his face. Seeing this scene, Jiang Shili was scared out of his wits. If he was pierced by this broken flying dagger, his life would be over.
A survival instinct rose from within his body. His entire body abruptly leaned backwards, barely dodging the attack of the flying dagger. However, the flying dagger still brushed past his forehead, drawing a line of blood on his forehead!
The moment Jiang Shili retreated, he immediately hid in the shadows in mid-air.
At this moment, Luo Zheng stood up with a sneer on his face. He gently waved his left hand and the broken throwing knife returned to his hand.
The speed of the confrontation between the two was extremely fast. This round of confrontation only happened in a flash, but the level of danger far exceeded any previous battle.
Many disciples could see that Luo Zheng and Jiang Shili were risking their lives!

Chapter 263
Luo Zheng was born with superhuman strength. His physical body was so strong that he would not be injured even if he was hit by a spiritual weapon. Even if Luo Zheng had a fortuitous encounter, he could not be envious.

Chapter 282
The sword technique that Hua Tianming cultivated was called Heavenly Sword. Heavenly Sword was not a Heaven-tier cultivation technique, nor was it an Earth-tier cultivation technique. It was not even a Mystic-tier or Mortal-tier cultivation technique because Heavenly Sword did not have a tier at all!
This cultivation technique was very special. It only had one diagram, and this diagram was called Heavenly Sword Diagram.
875 years ago, Heavenly Sword Diagram appeared out of nowhere and set off a reign of terror in the Eastern Region.
Several landowning clans, Burning Sky Palace, Blue Cloud Sect, and various experts strolling in the Eastern Region County all moved out one after another in order to obtain this "Heavenly Sword Diagram". It was rumored that this "Heavenly Sword Diagram" contained a supreme divine ability, and if it was refined in a single day, it would be able to achieve Dao and ascend!
In order to snatch this' Heavenly Sword Diagram ', countless heroes had died.
In the end, the Blue Cloud Sect took action and obtained the Heavenly Sword Diagram. Later, it was sent to Burning Sky Palace.
Many martial artists gnashed their teeth in hatred. However, whether it was the Blue Cloud Sect or Burning Sky Palace, they could not afford to offend them. They did not dare to enter Burning Sky Palace to snatch it.
However, a year later, a rubbing of the Heavenly Sword Diagram appeared on the market! Moreover, this rubbing plate was circulated from within the Burning Sky Palace.
As for why it came from Burning Sky Palace, no one knew. However, even if it was a rubbing, it was still crazily snatched by those martial artists! If they could not snatch it, they would spend a high price to buy it. The price of a rubbing of the Heavenly Sword Diagram was even raised to 10,000 gold taels!
This price was nothing to martial artists, but in the eyes of ordinary people, it was extremely shocking.
Therefore, many clans and merchants also spent a high price to buy rubbing. They would make a rubbing themselves and then sell it.
It could be said that at that time, almost everyone in the Eastern Region had a copy of the Heavenly Sword Diagram. Therefore, the price of the Heavenly Sword Diagram began to plummet. It fell from 10,000 gold taels to worthless.
One of the reasons was that too many people had rubbed the Heavenly Sword Diagram. It was originally just a piece of paper.
More importantly, those cultivators realized that they couldn't comprehend the Heavenly Sword from the Heavenly Sword Diagram ….
They couldn't understand the Heavenly Sword Diagram at all, nor did they know what it was.
After the martial artists realized that they had been deceived, they naturally discarded this Heavenly Sword Diagram like a pair of worn-out clogs, throwing it away like a piece of scrap paper.
From this point of view, Heavenly Sword was probably the most widely circulated cultivation method in the Eastern Region.
However, it wasn't that this cultivation method couldn't be cultivated. It was just that the requirements for comprehension and talent were too high, too high.
However, the Eastern Region was vast, and among the billions of humans, there were bound to be a few outliers who succeeded.
They were Zhu Kun from 633 years ago, Xuanyuan Daoyi from 400 years ago, and Ao Zhiyuan from 100 years ago.
However, although the three of them were talented, they had only managed to cultivate three swords. They were the Megrez Sword, the Dubhe Sword, and the Merak Sword.
Since ancient times, after so many generations, only three people had successfully cultivated it. Moreover, they had only managed to cultivate three swords of the 'Heavenly Sword'. From this, one could imagine how difficult it was to cultivate the 'Heavenly Sword'. This was also the reason why the 'Heavenly Sword Diagram' was so common that no martial artist would choose such a powerful cultivation method. Feeling the power of the golden palm, Hua Tianming's expression changed dramatically. He had struggled to break free from Pei Tianyao's Buddha's Reincarnation, but now he had to face such a terrifying palm. This was too …
"Is this Pei Tianyao's true strength?" Hua Tianming stared at the giant palm and gritted his teeth. He borrowed more Heaven Earth Yuan Qi from the sky, an even greater power of the firmament, and an even sharper Extreme Thunder Sword Intent to meet the palm head-on.
Victory or defeat depends on this! If I win, I'll be lucky. If I lose, I'll be doomed!
"Boom!"
The golden palm and azure lightning intersected in an instant. It was as if a star had exploded in the arena. The dazzling light made most people unable to open their eyes.
However, Luo Zheng outside the arena was not among them!
His brown pupils reflected light spots, and he saw every movement of the two people in the battle.
"Hua Tianming lost." Luo Zheng shook his head. Hua Tianming had previously said that he had a fifty percent chance of winning against Pei Tianyao and a ninety percent chance of winning after breaking through to the Illuminating Spirit Realm. Clearly, Hua Tianming had underestimated Pei Tianyao.
With Hua Tianming's current strength, he had no chance of winning against Pei Tianyao.
Moreover, Hua Tianming had comprehended Perfect Sword Intent. He had made a great breakthrough by washing his sword in the Sword-cleansing Pond of the Half Holy Land.
This strength was enough to make up for his lack of cultivation. In other words, Hua Tianming had been very naive when he thought that he had a ninety percent chance of winning against Pei Tianyao after entering the Illuminating Spirit Realm.
Pei Tianyao, the reincarnation of the Acalanatha … was too strong. Unless Hua Tianming had a new opportunity and broke through to the Divine Reflection Realm, he would not have the power to fight Pei Tianyao.
As the light on the stage dissipated, Hua Tianming used the Corrosive Blood Sword to support his tottering body. His thin and cold face was somewhat sad.
A young man who firmly believed that he would walk the path of the strongest had suffered two or three consecutive defeats. It was obviously a huge setback.
However, whether a setback was good or bad depended on the person.
Some people were arrogant, but their hearts of martial arts were weak. Once they were defeated, their hearts of martial arts would suffer a blow. Then, the growth of their cultivation would stagnate, and they might even develop a heart demon. It would be difficult for them to rise again in this lifetime.
On the other hand, some people were similarly arrogant, but their Martial Dao Heart was extremely firm. Even if they encountered setbacks, the more setbacks they faced, the more courageous they became. They would turn to firm their cultivation and seek greater opportunities, and they would definitely have the last laugh.
"I lost!" Hua Tianming carried the Corrosive Blood Sword on his back. Suddenly, the sad expression on his face was swept away. Obviously, Hua Tianming was the latter kind of person.

Pei Tianyao nodded. Such an opponent, no matter who it was, would be respectful.

Luo Zheng nodded, wondering why Pei Tianyao would say such a thing.

Although the Acalanatha was powerful, with Pei Tianyao's strength, he could not use it infinitely. Every time he used it, it would take a few days.
Pei Tianyao let Luo Zheng choose today or three days later.
If they fought today, then Pei Tianyao would not be able to exert his full strength!
At this point in the Peak Great Competition, both Luo Zheng and Pei Tianyao had lost interest in the concept of ranking.
The first place of the Peak Great Competition would receive a Clear Void Pill and an additional Immortal Tool.
In addition, the first and third place would have the right to walk the Blue Clouds Road.
Even if Luo Zheng was defeated, with the strength and talent that Luo Zheng had shown, Shi Jingtian was very likely to satisfy the Clear Void Pill and Immortal Tool reward.

Luo Zheng was not afraid of fighting. If Pei Tianyao's strength was not at its peak, even if Luo Zheng defeated him, then the long-awaited battle would not be perfect. His thoughts would not be smooth, so Luo Zheng had no reason to fight now.

The third place was Hua Tianming, the fourth place was Mo Yuxin, the fifth place was Wang Yun …
These rankings were already listed on the Green Clouds Road.

That was two million square crystals! Shi Jingtian was curious where Luo Zheng got such a large amount of square crystals.
Even if the seven noble families wanted to take out two million square crystals, it would not be easy. After all, the noble families were all fixed assets, so how could they have so much cash?

Fifty drops of Heaven's Eye Essence could be auctioned for two hundred and fifty thousand square crystals, and he only needed to smelt a hundred profound artifacts to obtain hundreds and thousands of drops of Heaven's Eye Essence!
Although the Heaven's Eye Essence could be sold in large amounts, and the price might get lower and lower, it was not difficult to gather two million square crystals.

Since Luo Zheng had the confidence to take out two million crystal cubes, he could guess with his eyes closed that the Zhang Clan was involved. However …

"Why?" Luo Zheng clenched his teeth. His heartbeat suddenly sped up, and his eyes immediately became completely red.

However, Luo Zheng was getting more and more excited. His eyes were getting brighter and brighter. On the other hand, although Pei Tianyao was the one being beaten, his face was full of depression and bitterness. It was as if he was riding a tiger and could not get off!
A warm current was constantly circulating in Luo Zheng's body. Luo Zheng not only did not feel pain, but also felt comfortable. How could he not be excited?
This kind of thrilling fight, but to Pei Tianyao, it was incomparably dull. It lasted for a while.
Finally, the golden light on Pei Tianyao's body slowly dimmed. Especially his chest and arms, which were often attacked by Luo Zheng, the golden light had faded, revealing the normal color of his skin.
Although the Invincible Vajra Body could be called an "indestructible body," in reality, it relied on the layer of golden light that was formed from the primordial energy on the surface. When that layer of golden light received too many blows, the primordial energy would slowly dissipate. Therefore, the Invincible Vajra Body was actually broken.
It was broken. It was broken by Luo Zheng's pure body. I was wrong. Luo Zheng is not a demon, he is a monster! "
"No, he is not a monster. He is simply a magical weapon, a humanoid magical weapon! He is not afraid of being beaten! "
This disciple was in disbelief. He compared Luo Zheng to a humanoid magical weapon. He did not know that he was right. Luo Zheng was indeed a humanoid magical weapon. Moreover, he was a humanoid magical weapon that was refined all the way!
After the last hit, the golden light on Pei Tianyao's body was finally dispersed by Luo Zheng. With a muffled groan, Pei Tianyao was pushed back seven or eight steps. Obviously, he had suffered internal injuries.
This kind of injury was nothing to Pei Tianyao. The key point was that he had lost the contest of physical strength. Moreover, he had lost thoroughly! Because he saw that Luo Zheng was still smiling, as if he hadn't been beaten enough.
At this time, Pei Tianyao had an illusion. He felt that Luo Zheng was deliberately leading him to beat him up! However, he was too embarrassed to voice out such an outrageous thought. After all, it was impossible for a psychopath in this world to be willing to be beaten up. Masochist?
However, Pei Tianyao did not know that his guess was right!
Luo Zheng wasn't satisfied yet. If it wasn't for the fact that he didn't want others to find out about his special body constitution, he really wanted Pei Tianyao to punch him a few hundred more times!
"It seems that I still overestimated myself," Pei Tianyao shook his head and said with a self-deprecating tone. "Originally, I thought that I could suppress you with my body, but it seems that it was just wishful thinking."
Pei Tianyao dispersed all the True Qi in his body, and a golden shadow appeared behind him. A Buddha statue began to slowly condense.
The Acala Wisdom King had two forms.
The first one was called the Hierophant Chakra, which was a ferocious and angry face. Pei Tianyao had used the Hierophant Chakra to deal with Hua Tianming.
The other was the Righteous Wheel Body, which had a silent smile on its face.
Although the Teaching Wheel Body was angry, it was not the most powerful form. The most powerful form of the Acala Wisdom King was the Righteous Wheel Body!
The shadow behind Pei Tianyao slowly became clearer in the process of condensing! It was completely different from the time when he dealt with Hua Tianming. This Acala Wisdom King had a Zen expression and a smile on its face like a spring breeze. It was the Righteous Wheel Body of the Acala Wisdom King.
Pei Tianyao was serious.
"This time, the Buddha statue is different. It actually has a smile on its face. Its momentum is far inferior to the time when he dealt with Hua Tianming!"
"I also think so. When Pei Tianyao fought against Hua Tianming, the Acalanatha statue was fierce and scary. However, this charmingly naive Buddha statue doesn't have any deterrence at all!"
"What do you know? This is called the Righteous Wheel Body!"
Everyone's discussion reached Luo Zheng's ears. He looked at the tall Acala Wisdom King's shadow, and his expression became more cautious.
The logic of these disciples was very idiotic. How could the Buddha statue's smile have anything to do with its power? Moreover, Luo Zheng could feel the killing intent hidden in the smile. It seemed that this Acala Wisdom King was even more terrifying than the angry Acala Wisdom King!
The Flowing Light Sword was once again taken out from Luo Zheng's spatial ring. He realized that he had to go all out.
Pei Tianyao's eyes flashed with a touch of light. He gently clapped his hands together. After three breaths of time, his two palms suddenly separated and once again clapped towards Luo Zheng.
The Acala Wisdom King's Righteous Wheel Body stretched out two huge palms and clapped towards Luo Zheng!
In front of those huge palms, Luo Zheng was like a mosquito. Luo Zheng had no doubt that if he was caught by those palms, he would be directly flattened!
"Pa!"
The two huge golden palms were extremely fast. In an instant, they clapped together and made a loud sound.
However, Luo Zheng's reaction was even faster. When the palms clapped together, he turned into a meteor and rushed upwards, jumping several feet high.
However, Luo Zheng could not fly. No matter how high he jumped, he would eventually fall down. Moreover, in a situation where he could not borrow strength from the air, it was even more difficult to dodge.
Pei Tianyao's eyes were clear. He waved his hand again, and the Acala Wisdom King's palm also slapped towards Luo Zheng.
"Bang!"
This time, Luo Zheng was directly hit by the palm. The huge force directly sent Luo Zheng flying. The huge inertia made him hit the barrier, and at the same time, after the rebound, he fiercely hit the ground. With several elders joining hands to support the barrier, it was incomparably sturdy compared to the battlefield's ground. However, Luo Zheng still hit the barrier, creating a big pit.
"Pei Tianyao should have used this move earlier. The earlier he used it, the earlier the fight would have ended. He can directly control the Acala Wisdom King's shadow. Luo Zheng simply did not fight with him!" A disciple said.
Most people did not speak at this moment. They were concerned about whether Luo Zheng could get up or not.
No matter who it was, after being slapped by the Acala Wisdom King's shadow and heavily hitting the ground, they would certainly not be able to get up. There was no need to look at them. Their life might be in danger. For example, their whole body's bones would be broken, or even explode and die!
However, no one dared to comment at this time because Luo Zheng himself was an Outlander. As an Outlander, common sense couldn't be used to describe him. How could he be defeated by Pei Tianyao so easily? This was simply unbelievable.
Sure enough … …
This kind of attack was fatal to other people, but Luo Zheng still climbed up from the pit. His eyes were still blooming, and it seemed that he did not suffer any serious injuries.
Even if his injuries were not serious, Luo Zheng found himself in trouble.
First of all, the speed of the Acala Wisdom King's shadow was too fast. The speed of the two palms on the shadow was synchronized with Pei Tianyao. In other words, when Pei Tianyao waved his hand, the shadow would also wave its hand at the same time.
The problem was that Pei Tianyao's hand only moved a few inches away, while the Acala Wisdom King's two palms moved seven or eight times. Pei Tianyao's waving speed was almost in the blink of an eye, and the speed of the two palms was also in the blink of an eye …..
It was too fast. It was difficult for Luo Zheng to dodge, not to mention how he could get close to Pei Tianyao.
If he could not attack him, he would definitely lose this fight. Even if Luo Zheng's endurance was amazing, it would consume a lot of energy. Pei Tianyao only needed to wave his hand. Even if he waved his hand for a day and a night, he estimated that he would not even blink.
Pei Tianyao was still racking his brains to come up with a countermeasure. He received the two palms and slapped them at Luo Zheng again. Pei Tianyao did not intend to give Luo Zheng any chance to catch his breath.
This time, Luo Zheng still chose to dodge. However, when Luo Zheng dodged the palms, he made another shocking decision. He threw his sword …..
The Flowing Light Sword flew a circle in the air before it started to fall freely.
While everyone was still confused about Luo Zheng's intentions, a blood red shadow suddenly emerged from his body. The shadow instantly condensed into a shape. It was Luo Zheng's Sword Spirit, Yao Ye.
Yao Ye charged towards the Flowing Light Sword as soon as he appeared. When Yao Ye grabbed the Flowing Light Sword, he sped up again and pointed it at Pei Tianyao!
Yao Ye was a swordsman, so he could naturally use a sword to fight. However, Luo Zheng did not have two good swords right now. Since he was unable to escape, Luo Zheng could only dodge the two palms while controlling Yao Ye to attack Pei Tianyao.
